title: IntermediaryDirectoryManifest
description: Proposed directory manifest. It tracks the three top-level intermediary collections in separate YAML files. It is not the assembled IntermediaryDefinition.

logical_identities.description: Relative path of the only file whose collection is logical_identities.

nodes.description: Relative paths of the files whose collection is nodes. One subject file per path.

edges.description: Relative path of the only file whose collection is edges.
